paper_metadata.title: Solving Portfolio Optimization Problems using Adiabatic Quantum Computing

experiments.description: Single-period portfolio optimization using D-Wave's hybrid Binary Quadratic Model (BQM) solver on a QUBO formulation with risk, return, budget, transaction cost, market impact, and ESG terms; evaluated across portfolios from 10 to 630 assets.

algorithm.variant: D-Wave hybrid Binary Quadratic Model (BQM) solver on QUBO portfolio optimization
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Initial asset amounts n_i,0 were randomly selected as uniformly distributed integers in [0, 2·(2^Np − 1)].

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Integer asset holdings n_i were binary-encoded as n_i = sum_{s=0}^{Np} 2^s x_{i,s}; total binary variables N = N_a N_p. Long-only formulation.
problem_formulation.objective_function: H = gamma * sum_{i,j} sigma_ij p_i n_i p_j n_j - sum_i mu_i p_i n_i + rho (B - sum_i p_i n_i)^2 + delta sum_i (n_i - n_i,0) p_i - epsilon sum_i n_i (n_i - n_i,0) p_i^2 - omega sum_i e_i n_i
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Penalty/reward terms embedded directly in the QUBO Hamiltonian.

problem_instance.description: Synthetic portfolio optimization instances with varying numbers of assets; single-period setting.

dataset_specification.description: Assets were randomly selected from a database of 2,000 synthetically generated assets; prices roughly 0-500, ESG scores 0-1, expected returns and correlations as single average annual values.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Uniformly distributed synthetic data generation; no additional preprocessing reported.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Each configuration was repeated three times; average run time, standard deviation, and average QPU access time were reported.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Synthetic data generation; random asset selection; QUBO construction; compilation/submission to D-Wave infrastructure.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Result aggregation, run-time averaging, standard deviation calculation, and energy/return analysis.

convergence_data.variance_across_runs: Low for smaller portfolios, noisier for larger portfolios.

speedup_claims.caveats: The paper reports short QPU access times, but total runtime is dominated by classical preprocessing and post-processing; no explicit classical baseline or speedup factor is provided.

experiments.description: Multi-period portfolio optimization using D-Wave's hybrid BQM solver on the same QUBO formulation, extended to 10 time intervals and evaluated across 10 to 68 assets.

algorithm.variant: D-Wave hybrid Binary Quadratic Model (BQM) solver on multi-period QUBO portfolio optimization
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Initial asset amounts n_i,0 were randomly selected as uniformly distributed integers in [0, 2·(2^Np − 1)].

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Integer asset holdings n_i were binary-encoded as n_i = sum_{s=0}^{Np} 2^s x_{i,s}; total binary variables N = N_a N_p. Long-only formulation.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Same Hamiltonian as the single-period case, evaluated over 10 time intervals.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Penalty/reward terms embedded directly in the QUBO Hamiltonian.

dataset_specification.description: Assets were randomly selected from a database of 2,000 synthetically generated assets.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Uniformly distributed synthetic data generation; no additional preprocessing reported.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Each configuration was repeated three times; average run time, standard deviation, and average QPU access time were reported.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Synthetic data generation; random asset selection; multi-period QUBO construction; compilation/submission to D-Wave infrastructure.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Result aggregation, run-time averaging, standard deviation calculation, and QPU access time analysis.

convergence_data.loss_curve_shape: Run time scaled roughly linearly with two distinct slopes.
convergence_data.variance_across_runs: Similar trends to single-period case; QPU access time slightly increased but was more consistent.

speedup_claims.conditions: 10-period portfolio optimization using D-Wave hybrid BQM solver
speedup_claims.caveats: No classical baseline or explicit speedup claim reported; only scaling behavior is discussed.

experiments.description: Benchmark comparison of D-Wave hybrid BQM and CQM solvers on the same portfolio QUBO/CQM-style formulation across 100 to 600 assets.

algorithm.variant: D-Wave hybrid BQM versus CQM benchmark for portfolio optimization
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Initial asset amounts n_i,0 were randomly selected as uniformly distributed integers in [0, 2·(2^Np − 1)].

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary encoding with N = N_a N_p logical binary variables for the BQM formulation; CQM used the same portfolio setup with explicit constraints.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Same portfolio Hamiltonian combining risk, return, budget, transaction cost, market impact, and ESG terms.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: BQM: penalty-based QUBO embedding; CQM: constrained quadratic model with explicit constraints.

problem_instance.description: Synthetic portfolio optimization benchmark comparing BQM and CQM solvers.

dataset_specification.description: Randomly selected assets from a database of 2,000 synthetically generated assets.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Uniformly distributed synthetic data generation; no additional preprocessing reported.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Each configuration was repeated three times; average run time, standard deviation, and average QPU access time were reported.

implementation_details.classical_solver: D-Wave exact solver used for a smaller 30-asset comparison in the accuracy analysis
implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Synthetic data generation; random asset selection; solver-specific model construction for BQM and CQM.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Run-time averaging, standard deviation calculation, QPU access time analysis, and energy histogram comparison.

convergence_data.loss_curve_shape: CQM required significantly more time to converge than BQM.
convergence_data.variance_across_runs: CQM had higher run-time standard deviation than BQM.

speedup_claims.conditions: Accuracy comparison used a smaller 30-asset instance; runtime benchmark compared BQM vs CQM across 100-600 assets
speedup_claims.caveats: The paper states CQM required significantly more time to converge than BQM, with about a fivefold increase at 600 assets, but does not provide exact numeric runtimes in text.

algorithm.variant: D-Wave BQM versus CQM solution-accuracy comparison
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Initial asset amounts n_i,0 were randomly selected as uniformly distributed integers in [0, 2·(2^Np − 1)].

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary encoding with N = N_a N_p logical binary variables.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Same portfolio Hamiltonian combining risk, return, budget, transaction cost, market impact, and ESG terms.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: BQM: penalty-based QUBO embedding; CQM: constrained quadratic model with explicit constraints.

problem_instance.description: 100-asset synthetic portfolio used to compare energy distributions from BQM and CQM solvers.

dataset_specification.description: Randomly selected assets from a database of 2,000 synthetically generated assets.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Uniformly distributed synthetic data generation; no additional preprocessing reported.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Each solver was rerun 100 times; energy frequency histograms were compared.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Synthetic data generation; random asset selection; solver-specific model construction.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Energy histogram construction and comparison across 100 runs.

convergence_data.variance_across_runs: CQM showed broader energy range and lower accuracy than BQM.

speedup_claims.conditions: Energy distribution comparison over 100 reruns per solver
speedup_claims.caveats: No speedup claim; the result is a qualitative accuracy/consistency comparison. CQM showed broader energy range and lower accuracy than BQM.

experiments.description: Accuracy comparison against D-Wave's exact solver for a smaller 30-asset portfolio, comparing BQM and CQM portfolio returns to exact optimal returns.

algorithm.variant: D-Wave BQM and CQM compared against D-Wave exact solver
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Initial asset amounts n_i,0 were randomly selected as uniformly distributed integers in [0, 2·(2^Np − 1)].

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary encoding with N = N_a N_p logical binary variables.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Same portfolio Hamiltonian combining risk, return, budget, transaction cost, market impact, and ESG terms.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: BQM: penalty-based QUBO embedding; CQM: constrained quadratic model with explicit constraints; exact solver used as reference.

problem_instance.description: 30-asset synthetic portfolio used for exact-solver comparison of total returns.
